# Frozen slot retrieval maintenance cases

These 20 authored cases compare production candidate retrieval against the real
corpus. Eight development cases and twelve new holdout cases were frozen before
the stage-01 source patch. They are maintenance inputs, not a blind authoring
study, live requester sessions, or evidence of native image quality.

Each `request.txt` preserves the input wording. Its `fixture.json` contains the
request envelope, independently developed baseline/core, neutral creative
controls, embodiment prose review, feature selection/audit, and freeze receipt.
The paired comparison keeps those inputs and seed 17 unchanged. Sensual, fetish
and surreal controls are zero; creativity is one. These explicit benchmark
overrides do not represent the project's saved defaults.

Seven cases have an occasion to retrieve; thirteen have no occasion proposal.
The new test checks source ownership, appropriate positive and nearest-negative
contexts, partial locks, source-bound prerequisite metadata, optional rejection
and final adoption evidence. Broader subject/domain precision is a later stage.

Preparation inputs, initial failures, public CLI commands, runtime receipts,
before/after packs and final audits remain in
`docs/research-evidence/photo-prompt/slot-retrieval-stage01-20261011`.
